self_reference_policy.rule: A verified subject must not embed the final verification attestation that verifies that same subject.

runtime_observability.note: Actor-scoped accessibility does not promote this frozen target beyond DEPLOYED. This historical target observation is not the verification state of the current repository commit.

truth_rules: Observation ingestion does not change the Current or Reference model.
Approval and application remain separate patch states.
Map, Feed, and Dashboard must read the same applied relation and revision.
Candidate PR evidence does not imply that the PR is merged or deployed.

features.label: Main LLM
features.note: The Work surface exists, but no assistant or context-loader adapter is connected.

features.label: Map
features.note: The contract verifies the fixture-backed projection and D1-backed applied-source indicator. It does not declare a full D1-backed Canonical Graph projection.

features.label: Dashboard
features.note: The contract requires Dashboard to read observation, proposal, applied-source, bitemporal, and revision values from D1. Broader topic and outcome projections remain unimplemented.

features.label: PMG implementation-source Golden Path
features.note: The contract verifies observe, classify, propose, approve without applying, separately apply, and project through one D1 operational model.

features.label: GitHub PR workflow
features.note: Execution state is resolved from an external attestation for the exact subject commit; it is not embedded here. Branch enforcement remains separately governed.
